claim_boundary: No superiority, generalisation, component-causal, bar, admission, held-out, confirmatory or paper-scale claim of any kind. A conditional rate on a gold-selected roster measures one factor of a later cell's expectation; it is never a pooled or roster-level number.
decision: Fly cell KPROBE: the 55-row centroid-key conversion probe (owner decision 145). It runs the locked PLAN plan with exactly one pin moved -- the intent-boundary Perception facet_source, from the written-key file to the centroid-key file -- on exactly the TRAIN Fold A rows whose gold intent boundary entry is NEWLY delivered under that key, and on nothing else. The comparator needs no contacts: the sealed PLAN arm on Fold A already holds these rows' answers. The read is P(correct given newly delivered) -- m of 55 -- as a Wilson interval with an exact Clopper-Pearson beside it, on INTENT correctness per row, gated on delivery having held on every row.
failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure. AT MOST ONE root-diagnosed recovery re-registration; a second failure closes the cell and the fix is proven on a four-row dry run. The budget is run-cumulative across attempts.
